verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes are designed to be created and controlled entirely programmatically via Python/JS/Go SDKs and a CLI, with no interactive/GUI dependency, making headless/CI use natural (modal-docs-19, modal-docs-25, modal-probe-4). Community evidence corroborates real-world CI/automation use: a developer built GitHub Actions self-hosted runners on Modal Sandboxes and another built a gRPC-driven agent runtime to control sandboxes (modal-comm-1, modal-comm-2). Missing for 10: an official CI/CD integration guide (e.g., GitHub Actions template) or first-party CI pipeline docs from Modal itself.
